traceability.notes: The plugin setup story is fully implemented. The codebase provides a standard ESLint plugin structure written in TypeScript, with a centralized rule registry, flat-config-based recommended/strict configurations, and robust error handling for both rule loading and plugin loading. Multiple Jest test files are explicitly tagged to this story and validate plugin exports, rule registration, config contents, error-handling behavior, and ESLint v9 CLI integration using a flat config. The project is structured and configured as a publishable npm package (`eslint-plugin-traceability`) with appropriate main/types fields and peer dependency on ESLint 9. User-facing documentation (README and ESLint 9 setup guide) describes installation and configuration clearly. Together, this evidence shows that all acceptance criteria and listed requirements for 001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP are satisfied.
